title: On the Beck--Chevalley condition
summary: Boolean hyperdoctrines provide an algebraic semantics for classical first-order logic with equality. In the definition of a Boolean hyperdoctrine, the Beck--Chevalley condition captures the commutativity of substitutions with quantifiers and with equality. Often, a generalization of these conditions is considered, which requires the commutativity of an appropriate square for every pullback square in the base category.
